interpretation: A weakened proposal is not thereby wrong -- the article may still support the claim in prose the token test does not reach. It means the recorded support rests on markup and a human should read the article before this proposal is accepted.
what_this_measures: resource_corpus.check_support judges support over the WHOLE wikitext, so an entity or content word occurring only inside an infobox, a category tag, an image filename or a <ref> counts the same as one in a sentence. This audit recomputes the same function over prose-masked content and records where the two disagree.
why_it_is_not_a_gate_change: The 181 proposals are pending PI accept/reject and none has been applied to the corpus, so no result is contaminated. Silently re-running the gate would move proposals the PI has not yet ruled on. The prose signal is recorded alongside instead, for that ruling to use.
